g.text: 10.0-12.6V regulated bench source ONLY. Set external current limit before applying power.

g.desc: 10.0-12.6V regulated bench source ONLY. Set external current limit before applying power.

g.text: PWR_FLAG marks intended source nets for ERC; it does not verify voltage, current, or safe operation.

g.desc: PWR_FLAG marks intended source nets for ERC; it does not verify voltage, current, or safe operation.

g.text: TPS3430: falling edges every35ms; guaranteed service interval25.9-46.8ms; reset170-230ms.

g.desc: TPS3430: falling edges every35ms; guaranteed service interval25.9-46.8ms; reset170-230ms.

g.text: ACT_EN = ARMED AND MCU_ENABLE AND NRST AND ESTOP_OK. Reset/E-stop clears arm latch.

g.desc: ACT_EN = ARMED AND MCU_ENABLE AND NRST AND ESTOP_OK. Reset/E-stop clears arm latch.

g.text: J_ESTOP pins1-2: external NC power contact; pins3-4: independent NC logic contact. No jumpers fitted.

g.desc: J_ESTOP pins1-2: external NC power contact; pins3-4: independent NC logic contact. No jumpers fitted.
